programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Big Break
programme.desc: Boss thought that breaking his arm was painful;but the true pain starts at pediatrician Dr. Kevin’s "jokes." Boss enlists the playgroup babies to defang the doctor of his "comedian’s disease." Tim obsesses about keeping his little brother safe.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)
programme.desc: There’s a new "babblist" in town- someone who claims to understand baby talk. Boss Baby spots this fraud right away;and must debunk his tactics before he scams the playgroup parents. Meanwhile;Tim tries to sell magazines with Boss Baby’s help.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Taxing Trauma of the Treacherous Tattle Trials Part II
programme.desc: Part two of the season finale finds George, Harold, Captain Underpants, and the Melvins trapped in the Doom Dome with rampaging nanobots. When the humans try to neautralize the bots, they find a new host: Captain Underpants. Now they must shrink down to go into Captain Underpants’ brain and defeat the nanobots’ leader, Nanozero. But they need help: Captain Underpants’ brain cells to the rescue! And when it’s all over, George and Harold will finally be able to go to summer camp.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Worrisome Wedge of the Water Warmongers
programme.desc: Harold and George can't wait to spend the summer together at camp. But not so fast, boys -- your old nemesis Mr. Krupp has a most unpleasant surprise.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Defenders Of The Wing Part 2
programme.desc: Hiccup, Mala, Astrid, Fishlegs, and Snotlout go searching for the now captured Eruptodon, but little do they know that Viggo has a sinister plan.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Gruff Around The Edges
programme.desc: When a distant cousin of the Twins named Gruffnut arrives on Dragon's Edge, Tuffnut tries to impress him, but Gruffnut may not be the hero he seems.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - The Prisoner
programme.desc: Team Voltron grapples with whether or not they can trust Lotor

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - A Few Good Grugs Valley Shine Day
programme.desc: The Valley has the first "try-all" against the Croods to see if Grug stole food for the Broods; Thunk asks Kevin to teach him to be more irresistible

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Railroad Ransom
programme.desc: When Butch LePray hold Jim for ransom, Lucky and Spirit team up with the unlikeliest of allies to get her father back

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Snow Blazer
programme.desc: While trying to get home from a snowy area north of their crater, the gang meets a lonely but helpful Trux named Snowblazer who helps them navigate.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Ooo Ooo's Jungle Drums
programme.desc: Raa Raa has found an infectious beat, and soon all the other animals in the jungle are joining in… except for Ooo Ooo, who just can't get the beat right. How can they find a way for all the friends to play together?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Topsy's Musical Stones
programme.desc: Topsy has readied the musical stones for a noisy game. Raa Raa has been left in charge, making sure that nobody jumps on them while Topsy reminds the other jungle inhabitants about the game. But temptation can be strong… especially when Ooo Ooo is about...

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Noisy Present
programme.desc: Raa Raa has made his friend Topsy a wonderful present - a noisy set of chimes. But she doesn't want them. Who else in the jungle might like a very noisy set of wind chimes?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Big Roar
programme.desc: Raa Raa finds it really funny that all his friends come running every time he roars really loudly. The other jungle inhabitants are less amused, they only come because there are worried about their friend. What is Raa Raa to do when he gets into trouble and nobody comes to his rescue?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Scritch Scratch
programme.desc: Raa Raa always scratches his claws in the morning, but his scratching post has fallen apart. He sets off to find himself a new one in the jungliest bit. When he does eventually find a new scratching post it is huge, how is he going to get it home again?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Hurry Up Raa Raa
programme.desc: Raa Raa has agreed to do too many things with too many people today. Will he be able to do them and keep all his friends happy? More importantly, will it make him happy?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Welcome to Pawston \ Ruff Day on the Job
programme.desc: Tag wants to bring her new neighbor, Scooch, to the Party in the Tree. But a series of traffic jams make Tag impatient, and she keeps trying to find different ways to get to the party. Thanks to Tag’s handiness - and one of Lady Lydia’s hats - they make it to the party just in time. \ Pawston’s new canine mail carrier keeps getting chased by dogs, so Tag and Scooch have to help him deliver the mail.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Gabby Gets The Hiccups
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a cat-in-the-box that startles Gabby, giving her the hiccups. Dr. Pandy and the Gabby Cats try several cures, but it isn't until CatRat scares the hiccups out of Gabby that they go away!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Hamster Kitties
programme.desc: When 6 adorable hamster kitties get loose in the dollhouse, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box head out to look for them. Along the way, Baby Box learns a lot about hamster kitties, which convinces Mama Box to let them live in the Craft Room.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Cat Cam
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a new camera that takes pictures with silly filters, CatRat uses it to lead Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats on a photographic scavenger hunt around the dollhouse!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Defenders
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes masks and capes for her and Pandy, they become the dollhouse defenders and must save the Gabby Cats from Bad Guy CatRat! In the Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song about her garden magic!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day at the dollhouse! However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of the whiny and fussy growing Itty Bitty Blossom and make sure it is in its permanent soil spot before it's fully grown.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Rangers
programme.desc: Kitty Ranger Team Leader Mama Box helps Kitty Ranger Gabby and Pandy get a lost Baby Me-Owl back home to its Mama in the Fairy Tale Garden. They embark on a hiking adventure! They learn about animal tracking, earn patches along the way, and ultimately, reunite Baby with Mama!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Meow-Mazing Games
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy, and Carlita prepare for the annual Meow-Mazing Games, they encounter stiff competition from the Doodads and must work together to bring home the coveted dollhouse trophy.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pandy's Birthday
programme.desc: It’s Pandy’s birthday!! The dollhouse is throwing a surprise party for him! Gabby goes room to room preparing all his favorite things for the party, but when the big moment comes, Pandy drops his cake! Gabby consoles him and tells him it’s even better - now, they have smash cake! They all hold up a piece and pose for a picture.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - The Dollhouse Hotel
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a suitcase and a hotel brochure, it’s time to take a trip to The Dollhouse Hotel! Hotel guests Gabby and Pandy check in with the Hotel Manager DJ Catnip then go to Mercat’s Spa and even order room service from Pillow Cat! For our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - A Knight's Tail
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train. The Gabby Cats help Gabby build the other three glow-in-the-dark train cars by creating shapes through interactivemusical games. In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, DJ Catnip sings a song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.desc: Raa Raa and the other animals keep slipping up on banana skins that are littering the jungle floor. Where could they have come from? Together the animals clear up the mess and discover who has been littering the jungle with banana skins.

programme.desc: It is nap time in the Jingly Jangly Jungle but Raa Raa is not tired and is determined to play hide and seek with his friends, whether they like it or not! But all this running about can be tiring work for a noisy little lion cub…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Two's Company

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Dark Park Bark Lark \ The Fast and the Curious
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch team up to get all of Scooch's chores done in time for the Barkapellas Bark In the Park In the Dark concert. \ Tag is so excited to join the Sam Whippet’s Race Cadets. But when Tag and Scooch show up at the racetrack, there’s lots of competition. And to complete the first challenge - a pedal car race - they’re going to have to work together.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Business Boss: Back in Baby
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Turf War
programme.desc: It's a turf war when Bounce House Bruiser Baby encroaches on Delivery Baby's tricycle park! Tina attempts to befriend Bruiser in order to woo her back to the bounce house, but naughty behavior is the only language Bruiser understands. Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Birthday Blues
programme.desc: Missing his old life on his birthday, Boss tries to have a full-fledged grown-up celebration in Chicago, but Carol is the only one able to chauffeur and take care of him. The two battle at every stop of the birthday party tour, but when Boss's old work nemesis sets him up for an Federal Investigation Sting at an improv comedy show, Boss and Carol are forced to work together to escape the law.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Inner Children
programme.desc: JJ reluctantly lets Tina take over her assistant duties for the day, but a Tina slip-up leads to an outbreak of town adults drinking diluted special formula that makes them all baby-brained. When JJ discovers this, she works with R &amp;amp; D Baby Simmons and Security Baby Katja to antidote the wobbling "Adult Babies" before Tina can find out and blame herself.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Poompf!
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits frames Boss and Tina’s startup company for exploding baby Iggy’s favorite stuffed animal, and Tina is forced to the sidelines to avoid any more bad press. As Crispin expands his plan to burst all the plush toys in the neighborhood, Tina discovers she can stop this by breaking open and rewiring a single toy doll. Unfortunately that doll is Baby Corp’s current head honcho, Pull-String CEO Baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Heat is On
programme.desc: On the hottest week of the year and a miserable time for babies, Boss and Tim infiltrates a country club with a very cool splash pad in order to find some way around their strict "no-babies" policy. Meanwhile, Banker Baby Benny visits the startup company to check on his investment. Tina has to cover up how the heat has split her coworkers into lawless factions fighting over a fan and a mist cooler.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Yellow 100
programme.desc: Finally promoted to CEO, Boss Baby sets his sights on achieving 100% Baby Love, while dealing with the annoying Puppies and Preeks who rented Baby Corp office space while Boss was gone. Tim and Danny become local heroes after saving a baby's life.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Pyg &amp; Tam
programme.desc: Boss Baby encounters a new threat to Baby Love: an adorable Baby TV show starring Pyg the Pygmy Goat, Tam the Tamandua, and their host Maria-Maria. Boss is told not to go to Corporate War by Board Baby Emiliano, so Boss tries to provoke his enemies to make the first move.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Goodbye Crood World
programme.desc: When Phil detects a meteor is hurtling towards the farm, the Bettermans and Croods must decide how to spend their last day on earth.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Sticky Business
programme.desc: Struggling to find their purpose on the Betterman farm, the Croods see an opportunity to prove their worth by harvesting Phil’s perilous (and sticky) bounceberries.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Guy Time
programme.desc: When Eep wants alone time with her new friend Dawn, Guy seeks a new friend of his own and finds an unlikely companion in Thunk.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Magma Breather
programme.desc: Tom has to keep his mom, Olivia, distracted while Jun, Alex, and D’Angelo use a new dragon to close off a cave leading to the Crystal Realm, and prevent her from discovering the dragons.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dragons of the Undead
programme.desc: When Feather is taken by a group of what appear to be zombie dragons, Alex finds her inner hero and rescues her friend.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Downpour
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder train a new species of aggressive tidal dragons to help the other riders put out a forest fire threatening ICARIS.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Who's a Good Baby?
programme.desc: A brainwashed Boss Baby breaks free from overly sanitized Bubbeezee products. He rallies the Playgroup Babies to run the company out of business by breaking every product in town.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunder Misters
programme.desc: Jealous of the Thunder Sisters, the men on the farm undergo a series of difficult initiation rituals to try and join the exclusive tribe of women.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Eep Walking
programme.desc: Eep loves action and adventure - it's in her blood. But when Eep starts adventuring in her sleep, she has to try to find the cause of her new sleep walking to avoid ending up in dangerous situations.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - The Gorgwatch Project
programme.desc: After Thunk and Guy tell Eep and Dawn a campfire story of Gorgwatch, a hideous monster who roams the woods, the girls are terrified. After a sleepless night, Guy and Thunk assure the girls it's just a made up story. Dawn and Eep are relieved until they find proof that Gorgwatch is real... and he's coming for them.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Decoy
programme.desc: Tom’s leadership abilities come into question by Eugene when his decisions lead to failure while attempting to confront Buzzsaw.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder discover a baby Nightlight and must bring him back to Thunder’s home realm.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder discover a baby Nightlight and must bring him back to Thunder’s home realm.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 2
programme.desc: When Thunder’s clan of fellow Nightlights is attacked by the Snow Wraith, Tom vows to rescue them.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Saving Shattermaster
programme.desc: When Mala and the Defenders of the Wing find a mysterious stranger who looks suspiciously like Dagur, Hiccup and Heather go to investigate.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Dire Straits
programme.desc: Viggo gets angry at the dragon riders continually interfering with his business and uses a deep sea dragon, the Submaripper, to control Berk's trade.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Postmortem
programme.desc: Tensions run high within team Voltron as they discuss Lotor’s fate and try to figure out their next move

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Wrestlebabia: The Musica Flowers For Munk
programme.desc: When Sandy can't join animal wrestling she poses as "Mandy Monkhuahua"; In order to help Munk, Grug sticks super worms up his nose that make him smarter

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Jam Jam
programme.desc: The PALs try to figure out why Marciela is acting so weird, while Miradero is gripped by April Fool’s Day fever

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Bridge
programme.desc: A group of Trux displaced by a volcano comes to Ty for help, and the gang has to work together to build a bridge to welcome their new guests.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Lots Of Raa's In The Jungle
programme.desc: Raa Raa and all his friends are finding out about different animals, they charge around being a pride of lions, a tower of giraffes etc… until Zebby wonders what zebras do… together the animals discover that zebras stampede… which is great fun and very noisy!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Favourite Things
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants to show Topsy his three favourite things. But when he gets to his friends house, they have disappeared. Raa Raa and his friends set out on a noisy adventure to find the missing objects

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Jungle Jiggles
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants a partner to dance a noisy stompy dance with. All the animals have their own way of dancing, apart from Zebby who says she is too shy to dance… or is she?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Great Big Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa has decided that the jingly jangly jungle is not jingly or jangly enough. He and his friends make lots of noise, but soon learn that they need to work together to make a wonderful jingly jangly jungle noise.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Nap Time Story
programme.desc: Topsy is going to read Zebby a naptime story. Raa Raa wants to make the noises to go with the story. But they are all too loud and poor Zebby can't get to sleep. Can Raa Raa find any quiet sleepy noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Go Bananas
programme.desc: Ooo Ooo is having a banana party. Raa Raa and the others have picked masses of lovely bananas, but how are they going to transport them back to Ooo Ooo's in time for the party?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Old Dog, New Tricks \ Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. \ Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - One Tricked Pony
programme.desc: An overworked and under loved Precious has to choose between the Templeton Family startup business or Crispin Biscuits’ fun playtime. Meanwhile, the company makes its first purchase: upgraded communicators! R &amp; D Baby Simmons is reluctant to fix the model they have, which picks up signals from her favorite lvorian soap opera, "Bridges Aflame." Over a live broadcast, Simmons must convince the cast to tie up every loose plot thread before she has to lose the signal forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Federal Slumber Party
programme.desc: Uncle Benji makes a surprise visit to the Templeton Family with a cute baby of his own: Lil Bit Guerrero! Tina gets jealous of Carol doting on Lil Bit, while Benji reveals that in order to make his daughter proud of him, he’s applied to become a Federal Agent. With Boss Baby’s cover at stake, it’s up to the Templeton Family to get Benji out of their hair as he sniffs around for a case that could garner the attention from federal law enforcement.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Floaties
programme.desc: A bummed out Tina takes a vacation to the baby resort, Floaties! However, her mind is still back at work, and struggled to actually enjoy her vacation. And it gets worse when Crispin Biscuits switches electronic ID tags with her, causing everyone to assume Tina actually is Crispin Biscuits. With Crispin having booked her for a seemingly endless stay, Tina is trapped in a paradise nightmare, and in a tunnel of madness starts to think that she may even be Crispin.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Breaking The Bank
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits heists the underwater Baby Bank in an attempt to steal all the funds from Boss and Tina’s new company. Boss, Tina and Banker Baby Benny must infiltrate the bank via submarine to stop this high-stakes aquatic robbery. But Boss and Tina struggle to stay on the same page after Tina admits that she might, kinda, sorta be thinking about retiring as a regular baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Hate That Baby!
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. Meanwhile, Tina needs to end Crispin Biscuits’ attacks on their company before she can finally hang up her boss role and retire to a life of cuddle time with daddy and mommy.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - North of the Border
programme.desc: With his identity as a fugitive businessman exposed, Boss Baby has been hiding out in the lawless land of Canada. But he’s forced back into action over a new crisis with Baby Love: several criminals have copycatted Boss’s fugitive strategy, somehow turning themselves into babies to hide out from the law. While Tina works on exposing these new fake baby criminals to the world, Boss makes a dangerous journey across Canada to sneak back over the U.S. border.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Intensive Purposes
programme.desc: After getting caught at the border, Boss, Tim, JJ, and Pip have to organize an escape from a "former novelty restaurant turned interrogation facility" using only the four phone calls they’ve been given. Meanwhile, Tina has a plan for Dez to infiltrate the criminal baby organization to break them up from the inside, but it’s complicated when Tina’s new assistant Temp Baby Aubrey accidentally takes over Dez’s undercover baby criminal role.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Unshakeable Bear
programme.desc: Boss scours Chicago to find his old co-worker nemesis Board Member Bradley, his key to cutting a deal with the Federal Agents for his freedom. However, he must lose the tail of Canada’s most notorious fugitive tracker, a trained bear cub named Henri. Meanwhile, Tina is trapped at home with her paranoid grandma Yaya, forced to prove to her that she’s not a criminal baby like the news is causing Yaya to believe.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Ba-Ba Town
programme.desc: The Templeton’s hometown is overtaken by baby criminals, with Temp Baby Aubrey in charge. Boss has 48 hours to somehow restore them all to adulthood and turn them in, or face jail time himself. With Tina now acting like a dark angel of vengeance after feeling betrayed by Aubrey, Boss is forced to assemble a team from unlikely odd friends. Together, they launch a final mission to settle old scores and clear Boss Baby’s name.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Cause for The Paws
programme.desc: Po, at the top of his game but lonely, comes across two weasels stealing an earthquake causing gauntlet and tries to stop them, but inadvertently destroys a town. He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight’s Code
programme.desc: Po and Blade's personalities clash as they track Klaus and Veruca and fight off some of Po's old foes. Blade gets to see Po's kung fu mastery, but doesn't agree to team up with him until she realizes that he accidentally holds the key to finding Klaus and Veruca: he has a piece of the WuGao Gauntlet. Meanwhile, Klaus and Veruca continue on their path of destruction while looking for the mysterious "Lotus".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lotus
programme.desc: Po's moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk (Zhen) out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Legend of Master Long-Tooth
programme.desc: Po and Blade must convince a deceased comic book writer's son to give them information about an unreleased comic that may point them toward the next weapon: a whip of fire. However, after the events of 103 Po is now a wanted criminal, so the Emperor's Forbidden Company arrives and captures him. Torn between saving Po and the mission she's sworn to complete, Blade flees and abandons Po.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Gateway to The Desert
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Veruca’s mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Veruca’s rekindled powers.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Slow Boat to England
programme.desc: Po and Blade head to the docks to take Klaus and Veruca to England, and Po tries to have fun with her on their last day together. However, Klaus and Veruca break free and hold Po hostage; Blade shockingly gives up the location of the fire whip to save him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhmini’s hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years she’s been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Conference Room B
programme.desc: Boss promises Tim he'll help make their parents' anniversary present, but after Puppy Co. and Baby Corp's fight over a conference room escalates, he sends Hendershot is his stead. Hendershot, armed with a file on all of Tim's wants and needs, tries to keep Tim happy.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Boss tries to rename the local soccer team to "The Babies", but after Danny gets involved in the popularity race with his name, "The Hot Dogs", the town becomes divided. Boss creates a crack team of Baby Corp employees to game plan solutions to the worst outcomes.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Night Owls
programme.desc: Boss arranges a sleepover with Quiet Psycho Baby to get access to her father the Mayor's day planner, hoping to plant his own pro-baby agenda. However, staying up all night has the unexpected consequence of delusional over-tiredness! Tim sneaks into an art film and decides he has to be a grown-up now, so Mom and Dad try to "kid" him up again.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Game Nightmare
programme.desc: When the Bettermans invite the Croods to join their family game night, two things become clear: Phil needs to win and Grug hates to lose.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - What Goes Eep Must Come Dawn
programme.desc: After a crowverine gliding mishap, Dawn loses her confidence and tells Eep she's taking a break from adventures. Eep convinces Dawn to join her on one last adventure - climbing Grrr Mountain.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Parental Stridence
programme.desc: When Hope oversteps by trying to teach Sandy manners, Ugga gets her revenge by challenging Hope to do the impossible: civilize Thunk.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Tangled Web

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Follow the Lightning: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and the riders go in search of Thunder and must face a gauntlet of dangerous dragons to find their lost friend. Along the way, Tom reveals his big secret to D’Angelo and Alex.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Follow the Lightning: Part 2
programme.desc: Tom and the riders help Thunder, who is seeking revenge against the dragons that chased off his family.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Yellow 100
programme.desc: Finally promoted to CEO, Boss Baby sets his sights on achieving 100% Baby Love, while dealing with the annoying Puppies and Preeks who rented Baby Corp office space while Boss was gone. Tim and Danny become local heroes after saving a baby's life.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Pyg & Tam
programme.desc: Boss Baby encounters a new threat to Baby Love: an adorable Baby TV show starring Pyg the Pygmy Goat, Tam the Tamandua, and their host Maria-Maria. Boss is told not to go to Corporate War by Board Baby Emiliano, so Boss tries to provoke his enemies to make the first move.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Conference Room B

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Skate or Dawn
programme.desc: When Guy invents a primitive skateboard, Eep and Dawn have a blast trying new tricks. But when the punch monkeys want to take over the girl's awesome new skate spot, Dawn and the punch monkeys enter a skate-off to win back the skate canyon once and for all.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Phil's Fun Farm

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Joy Story

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - First Flight: Part 1

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP12
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP1
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP31
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP20
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP16
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP17
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP40
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 女士的品格(台)第33集
programme.desc: KPI至上的工作狂姚薇在事業上升期發現自己懷孕了。得知姚薇懷孕，公司挖角安暢來商務部做總監。安暢不僅有資歷、老公加持，還是頂客族，完美避開女性在職場的部分困境。糾結後，姚薇選擇生下孩子。就是這個決定讓一切發生了變化。

programme.title: 說人解字第8集
programme.desc: 以100多位歷史人物為主題，共說了近400則的成語故事，這些耳熟能詳的成語，出自數百年甚至是千年前，包括孔孟老莊、李白、杜甫、曹操、劉備……等上百位真實的、虛構的人物。以特有的說書方式，講述這些人的生平以及相關成語典故，輕鬆逗趣卻又寓意深遠。

programme.title: 遇見一首詩第26集
programme.desc: 尋找一首詩，遇見一首詩，在愛的熱望裡，在典範的仰望下，在社會關懷的悲憫嘆息聲中。詩人教授帶你品讀，進入現代詩的迷人世界。

programme.title: 名人書房第61集
programme.desc: 閱讀引導我們漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中13位名人的讀書故事，13段動人的奇幻旅程~繼2015年與中天電視合作製播《名人牀頭書》節目，邀請39位名人深度分享閱讀帶來的影響及美好，冠德玉山教育基金會於2018年起獨立製作《名人書房》影片，以閱讀為主題的實景記錄，期待能呈現文學、藝術、設計、空間等風格意義，邀請王偉忠、五月天/石頭、江坤俊、姚謙、郎祖筠、許芳宜、郭重興、曾文誠、曾寶儀、鄭豐、徐薇X大成、劉安婷X呂冠緯等跨界名人，由資深主播詹慶齡擔任主持人，在漫漫的引言互動中，侃侃而談對生命的感知、閱讀經驗的分享與追夢的過程。影片片頭「名人書房」由《每日一字》書法家張炳煌揮毫，配樂為大提琴家呂超倫演奏

programme.title: 生活智多星第1657集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 閻小妹第33集
programme.desc: 這是一座介於鄉村與都市間的迷你化、可愛化的小城鎮-東閰鎮。裡面住著許多東方傳說中的人物、妖怪以及擬人化的動物。故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。在東閰鎮裡，每天可以認識許多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每個角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被發掘。閰小妹將帶領著迪米歐與同學們在東閰城裡一起學習、一起探險，也將引導觀眾，重新認識華人文化裡，最具奇幻魅力的異想世界。

programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 名人書房第61集
programme.desc: 閱讀引導我們漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中13位名人的讀書故事，13段動人的奇幻旅程~繼2015年與中天電視合作製播《名人牀頭書》節目，邀請39位名人深度分享閱讀帶來的影響及美好，冠德玉山教育基金會於2018年起獨立製作《名人書房》影片，以閱讀為主題的實景記錄，期待能呈現文學、藝術、設計、空間等風格意義，邀請王偉忠、五月天/石頭、江坤俊、姚謙、郎祖筠、許芳宜、郭重興、曾文誠、曾寶儀、鄭豐、徐薇X大成、劉安婷X呂冠緯等跨界名人，由資深主播詹慶齡擔任主持人，在漫漫的引言互動中，侃侃而談對生命的感知、閱讀經驗的分享與追夢的過程。影片片頭「名人書房」由《每日一字》書法家張炳煌揮毫，配樂為大提琴家呂超倫演奏

programme.title: 說人解字第8集
programme.desc: 以100多位歷史人物為主題，共說了近400則的成語故事，這些耳熟能詳的成語，出自數百年甚至是千年前，包括孔孟老莊、李白、杜甫、曹操、劉備……等上百位真實的、虛構的人物。以特有的說書方式，講述這些人的生平以及相關成語典故，輕鬆逗趣卻又寓意深遠。

programme.title: 遇見一首詩第26集
programme.desc: 尋找一首詩，遇見一首詩，在愛的熱望裡，在典範的仰望下，在社會關懷的悲憫嘆息聲中。詩人教授帶你品讀，進入現代詩的迷人世界。

programme.title: 生活快易通第4集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第1集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 閻小妹第33集
programme.desc: 這是一座介於鄉村與都市間的迷你化、可愛化的小城鎮-東閰鎮。裡面住著許多東方傳說中的人物、妖怪以及擬人化的動物。故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。在東閰鎮裡，每天可以認識許多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每個角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被發掘。閰小妹將帶領著迪米歐與同學們在東閰城裡一起學習、一起探險，也將引導觀眾，重新認識華人文化裡，最具奇幻魅力的異想世界。

programme.title: 人間佛學院第267集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第262集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 女士的品格第34集
programme.desc: KPI至上的工作狂姚薇在事業上升期發現自己懷孕了。得知姚薇懷孕，公司挖角安暢來商務部做總監。安暢不僅有資歷、老公加持，還是頂客族，完美避開女性在職場的部分困境。糾結後，姚薇選擇生下孩子。就是這個決定讓一切發生了變化。

programme.title: 閻小妹第37集
programme.desc: 這是一座介於鄉村與都市間的迷你化、可愛化的小城鎮-東閰鎮。裡面住著許多東方傳說中的人物、妖怪以及擬人化的動物。故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。在東閰鎮裡，每天可以認識許多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每個角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被發掘。閰小妹將帶領著迪米歐與同學們在東閰城裡一起學習、一起探險，也將引導觀眾，重新認識華人文化裡，最具奇幻魅力的異想世界。

programme.title: 阿母第27集
programme.desc: 母親簡稱母，或稱媽媽，是一種親屬關係的稱謂，是子女對雙親中的女性的稱呼。母親和子女是重要的直系親屬關係之一，通常具有親密關係。一般指生育小孩的女人（即生母）；但在有些狀況下，僅養育小孩（養母），或再婚配偶（繼母）、結誼長輩（義母），或是僅提供卵子讓精子與之結合（代孕母）（例如捐卵等輔助生殖技術），但並未親自生育小孩的女人也可如此稱呼。

programme.title: 寶島西米樂守護第150集
programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第388集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 阿母第28集
programme.desc: 母親簡稱母，或稱媽媽，是一種親屬關係的稱謂，是子女對雙親中的女性的稱呼。母親和子女是重要的直系親屬關係之一，通常具有親密關係。一般指生育小孩的女人（即生母）；但在有些狀況下，僅養育小孩（養母），或再婚配偶（繼母）、結誼長輩（義母），或是僅提供卵子讓精子與之結合（代孕母）（例如捐卵等輔助生殖技術），但並未親自生育小孩的女人也可如此稱呼。

programme.title: 烤箱讀書會第9集
programme.desc: 為提倡親子共讀、快樂閱讀，全新打造專屬節目《烤箱讀書會》！日本國際兒童圖書評議會主席松居直先生說：「閱讀應該是一件快樂的事！」。不管大人或小孩，每個人都喜歡做有趣的事，如果能將閱­讀和有趣的事結合在一起，應該就能創造充滿趣味的閱讀經驗，在這個節目當中，將帶領小朋友動手做點心，利用烘焙時間，和他們共讀一本圖畫書，不僅分享故事，還有動聽的詩­歌，讓更多大小朋友透過電視，共同參與這個充滿樂趣又有益身心的閱讀活動。

programme.title: 葬送的芙莉蓮第15集
programme.desc: 魔法使芙莉蓮與勇者欣梅爾等人一同經歷了10年的冒險，最終打倒魔王，替世界帶來了和平。芙莉蓮身為活了千年以上的精靈，她與欣梅爾等人約好再次相會後，便獨自踏上旅程。在那之後過了50年，芙莉蓮造訪欣梅爾的所在地，但她與50年前長得一模一樣，相較之下欣梅爾已經老去，早已時日無多。之後，芙莉蓮親眼見到過世的欣梅爾，深深體悟自己至今都沒有去「了解他人」，對此感到懊悔的她，決定「為了了解他人」而踏上旅程。

programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 在愛之外第14集
programme.desc: 郭翠花(范宸菲_飾)從小是養女，努力工作勤勉賺錢，在遇見理想的婚姻對象後走入婚姻，隨著先生的房地產事業扶搖直上，累積了很多財富，成為董娘，隨著先生的事業越做越大，涉足的場所越來越複雜，先生開始出入賭場與歡場，進而有了外遇，並與婚外情的對象產下一女，但因房地產的崩盤與先生的經營不善，事業走下坡，終至公司解散，負債累累，就在同時，女主角郭翠花也是最後知道真相的人…然而她必須在先生喪志時設法生活下去，為了家與孩子靠著勞力重新站起來。

programme.title: 新何處是我家第30集
programme.desc: 蕭秀珠師姊從小歷經顛沛流離的童年，渴望有個家。婚後與夫婿陳松田經營塑膠袋和免洗餐具，日進斗金，但秀珠脾氣卻日益爆烈，親子夫妻關係日危，再經過與生父相認卻訣別，母親墜河往生的人生起伏悲歡，終於走入慈濟，毅然結束正熾的事業，投入環保志業，最後在慈濟找到安身立命的地方，也找回家庭幸福！

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6694集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 人文講堂第368集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 法譬如水第459集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.desc: 蕭秀珠師姊從小歷經顛沛流離的童年，渴望有個家。婚後與夫婿陳松田經營塑膠袋和免洗餐具，日進斗金，但秀珠脾氣卻日益爆烈，親子夫妻關係日危，再經過與生父相認卻訣別，母親墜河往生的人生起伏悲歡，終於走入慈濟，毅然結束正熾的事業，投入環保志業，最後在慈濟找到安身立命的地方，也找回家庭幸福！

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6694集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 小主播看天下WOW第444集
programme.desc: 透過每天不同的小單元，培養小朋友創意、幽默、探索、同理、勇氣、夢想、美感、團隊等八大特質，讓小朋友在家也可以探索未知、環遊世界！拓展國際觀，儲備愛物惜地球的小公民知識。

programme.title: 現代心素派第3038集
programme.desc: 走訪全台灣，於節目中點綴各地風光，運用各地農產、當令蔬果，由慈濟志工的香積妙廚，派出一桌素食美餚，進而推廣佛教護生理念與慈濟「心素食儀」的人文涵養。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1060集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛學漢醫第301集
programme.desc: 讓世界看懂中醫，打破中醫的框架迷思，發揮預防重於治療的優點，讓台灣走向樂活社會。

programme.title: 365日日素第582集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透過簡單的烹調方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第533集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 高僧傳第1528集

programme.title: 慈濟充滿愛第241集

programme.title: 大愛夜安新聞 LIVE

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第174集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 大愛學漢醫第301集
programme.desc: 讓世界看懂中醫，打破中醫的框架迷思，發揮預防重於治療的優點，讓台灣走向樂活社會。

programme.title: 在愛之外第16集
programme.desc: 郭翠花(范宸菲_飾)從小是養女，努力工作勤勉賺錢，在遇見理想的婚姻對象後走入婚姻，隨著先生的房地產事業扶搖直上，累積了很多財富，成為董娘，隨著先生的事業越做越大，涉足的場所越來越複雜，先生開始出入賭場與歡場，進而有了外遇，並與婚外情的對象產下一女，但因房地產的崩盤與先生的經營不善，事業走下坡，終至公司解散，負債累累，就在同時，女主角郭翠花也是最後知道真相的人…然而她必須在先生喪志時設法生活下去，為了家與孩子靠著勞力重新站起來。

programme.title: 365日日素第581集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透過簡單的烹調方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第531集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第498集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1061集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6695集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 新何處是我家第31集
programme.desc: 蕭秀珠師姊從小歷經顛沛流離的童年，渴望有個家。婚後與夫婿陳松田經營塑膠袋和免洗餐具，日進斗金，但秀珠脾氣卻日益爆烈，親子夫妻關係日危，再經過與生父相認卻訣別，母親墜河往生的人生起伏悲歡，終於走入慈濟，毅然結束正熾的事業，投入環保志業，最後在慈濟找到安身立命的地方，也找回家庭幸福！

programme.title: 行動現場第544集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.desc: ｢綜藝玩很大｣由亞洲娛樂天王吳宗憲、小鬼黃鴻升主持， 每集任務關卡無極限，來賓個個拚得你死我活， 不只玩很大，更跟你玩真的， 到底藝人們為了輸贏能多犧牲？ 中視週六晚上10點【綜藝玩很大】

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第617集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2096集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1276集

programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第21集
programme.desc: 同名小說改編。青丘九尾狐族女君白淺（楊冪）為四海八荒第一絕色，化名司音拜入戰神墨淵（趙又廷）門下，因而捲入天族與翼族之戰。在墨淵封印東皇鐘七萬年後，白淺代師再次封印東皇鐘而受傷，失去記憶與修為落入凡塵歷劫，卻因此變成凡人素素，與天族太子夜華（趙又廷）歷經三生三世的情緣…

programme.title: 舊金山美容院第5集
programme.desc: 被捲入爭議事件失業後，男人開了一家美容院還債，隨後卻得到了足以證明自己清白的證據。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第40集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第22集
programme.desc: 同名小說改編。青丘九尾狐族女君白淺（楊冪）為四海八荒第一絕色，化名司音拜入戰神墨淵（趙又廷）門下，因而捲入天族與翼族之戰。在墨淵封印東皇鐘七萬年後，白淺代師再次封印東皇鐘而受傷，失去記憶與修為落入凡塵歷劫，卻因此變成凡人素素，與天族太子夜華（趙又廷）歷經三生三世的情緣…

programme.title: 霹靂英雄戰紀之刜伐世界第25集
programme.desc: 中原正道領袖素還真為救摯友一線生，前往未知地域『刜伐世界』，經由浮動山城之主夢不覺指點，方得知進入之法，而夢不覺身上也背著與龍族的血海深仇，他又將對妖漫地獄產生怎樣的影響，吹響傳說之物君王贊的夢不覺之徒黃花落，其身份更是驚人，竟是龍族之後代，兩人又將會有何衝突！

programme.title: 護心第3集
programme.desc: 靈龍天曜懷著滿心喜悅準備和廣寒門掌門素影成親，誰知素影另有圖謀，她計畫取龍鱗制一件龍鱗鎧甲，為護她真正所愛之人不傷不死，卻不想天曜拼死在最後一刻將凝聚巨大靈力的護心鱗打出，素影大怒，將天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。護心鱗飛躍山河，落入了一心口缺失的棄嬰雁回胸膛，填補了雁回心臟缺失，讓她得以活命。十年後，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌門淩霄收養，納入辰星山成為他的弟子。因識海未開，靈力全無，仍是一星弟子，因此被同門嘲笑。一次偶然的機會，觸發了雁回心口護心鱗的力量，靈龍之火瞬間燒毀了鎖妖塔的結界，塔內的妖族趁機逃跑。淩霄得知後將其趕出辰星山，雁回誤解了師父，覺得道不同不相為謀，便瀟灑下山去永州成找好朋

programme.desc: 靈龍天曜懷著滿心喜悅準備和廣寒門掌門素影成親，誰知素影另有圖謀，她計畫取龍鱗制一件龍鱗鎧甲，為護她真正所愛之人不傷不死，卻不想天曜拼死在最後一刻將凝聚巨大靈力的護心鱗打出，素影大怒，將天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。護心鱗飛躍山河，落入了一心口缺失的棄嬰雁回胸膛，填補了雁回心臟缺失，讓她得以活命。十年後，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌門淩霄收養，納入辰星山成為他的弟子。因識海未開，靈力全無，仍是一星弟子，因此被同門嘲笑。一次偶然的機會，觸發了雁回心口護心鱗的力量，靈龍之火瞬間燒毀了鎖妖塔的結界，塔內的妖族趁機逃跑。淩霄得知後將其趕出辰星山，雁回誤解了師父，覺得道不同不相為謀，便瀟灑下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 霹靂魔封第45集

programme.title: 喝酒吧！笨蛋第2集
programme.desc: 故事講述曾是國際調酒大賽冠軍的調酒師阿榮，風光一時的他，卻因意外失去嗅覺跌入人生谷底，夜夜買醉、渾渾噩噩。某次，他遇上一名亂入酒吧的小混混，對方竟用店內食材亂調「怪味酒」，甚至加入「特殊液體」作為神秘原料，阿榮一飲而下竟奇蹟般恢復味覺。而好友 Leo因投資有成，出資買下酒吧後，阿榮重新站回吧檯，為每位登門客人調製專屬酒品，也看遍人生百態。

programme.title: 咱的城 咱的市 咱台灣的味第26集
programme.desc: 台灣是個美麗的寶島，一年四季都有不同的景色以及不同的物產，從本島到離島各地皆擁有自己獨特的味道，而更為人所津津樂道的除了台灣的美食，台灣的人情味更是世界聞名。 這次【咱的城 咱的市 咱台灣的味】將帶觀眾環島一周，以及去到澎湖及金門，走入各地的市場，以不同的飲食文化、季節性產物、店家手路菜、創意料理等角度，帶領大家了解各地美食背後的文化底蘊，增廣對當地飲食文化的認識，也增加節目的豐富度及視野。

programme.title: 包青天第161集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 故事發生在2011年12月聖誕節前夕。患了小胖威利癥的主角胖達，極其愛吃，同學總是利用貪吃這點戲弄他。他的家人也不知道其為罕見疾病，胖達爸爸更是逃避對孩子的愛，埋頭工作。即便如此孩子仍是關心著爸爸，並在聖誕夜為爸爸許了個願望，踏上尋聖誕老公公之旅，展開他的奇幻冒險。

programme.title: 8號公園第9集
programme.desc: 在8號公園附近住著一群人，每個人都有自己的故事。笑眉，一個雖然家庭幸福卻不幸家貧的女孩，當了人家童養媳，太過認真的生活，讓50幾歲的她反而和家人情感疏離，兒子受不了她應對無責任老公的懦弱，婆婆生病了只能依賴她；風生，一個懼怕衝突的大學教授，處處隱忍，卻發現自己忍過頭得了胃癌，病極思痛，他開始決心為自己活一把；秀女是個幸福的太太，唯一的煩惱就是丈夫掌控欲太強，卻偏偏在這毫無細縫的生活中，她想起了自己年輕時的長笛夢想，那些音樂家們因為演奏受傷的手腕，她是因為家事做得太多？她不服氣；淑芬是一個內外皆堅強的女性，在老公無預警過世之後，她的堅強漸漸潰堤，相信網路上詐騙份子的甜言蜜語，卻忘了解決自己內心真

programme.title: 家第15集
programme.desc: 家是指一個作為個人、家庭或部落成員的居住空間，通常是房屋或其他建筑物，也可能是組合屋、營帳、船屋或洞窟。是一個可供個人或家庭在里面飲食、睡眠和儲存財產的地方，也是人們寄托情感的中心。根據《世界人權宣言》第12條規定，個人的住所不允許無理的侵犯。

programme.desc: 近年來，全球牧者普遍領受到一個重要的異象：禱告是復興的唯一關鍵。在2005年的禱告年，GOOD TV特別邀請了多位具有禱告恩賜和全面知識的牧者，製作了五個領域的全面禱告專題節目，引導弟兄姊妹更廣泛地守望我們的世界。這些專題將幫助人們更深入地了解禱告的重要性，教導他們在各個領域中以禱告為基礎，尋求神的帶領和引導。通過這樣的節目，人們將被鼓勵和激發，積極參與禱告，並為復興和神的國度的來臨而努力。

programme.title: 福氣人生第753集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 今天不講理第135集
programme.desc: 主持人柳子駿牧師帶領我們通過「不講理」的方式，透過各種生活體驗和與來賓的互動，尋找真理。每集節目中，他展示了不同的一面，讓觀眾看到牧師在生活中的另一個角色。他不僅走下講台，還走上街頭，走出教會，走入社會，用牧師的眼光來看待世界。這個節目通過與各種人和情境的互動，探索真理的存在和應用。柳子駿牧師透過身歷其境的體驗，與觀眾一起學習和成長。他以開放的心態走入社會，理解並回應現實生活中的問題和挑戰。這個節目將啟發觀眾重新思考生活中的各種情境，從不同的角度看待事物，並透過學習和體驗，找到真理的啟示。柳子駿牧師的親身參與和互動，使節目更加貼近觀眾的生活，並提供實用的智慧和啟發。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第362集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 客人主人第1集
programme.desc: 描述客家族群從中國大陸遷移到台灣開墾打拚的故事。

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所第66集
programme.desc: 邀請各路高手擔任所長與您分享好音樂與創作心情，讓您睡前在美妙的歌聲中放下一整天緊繃的情緒，三不五時還會告訴你音樂小知識。

programme.title: 客庄走透透第102集
programme.desc: 這個節目將帶領觀眾們探索台灣各地的客庄，讓他們身歷其境地感受客家文化的獨特風情。

programme.title: 客語半生熟第30集
programme.desc: 這是全球第一個、也是唯一專屬客家、全程使用客語發音的電視頻道。

programme.title: 牽紙鷂的手第19集
programme.desc: 一所充滿愛的「陽光學園」，四位風格迥異的老師，將帶領七位來自不同家庭背景的中輟學生，學習面對青春人生的酸甜苦辣，尋找屬於他們各自飛翔的一片天。

programme.title: 日頭下‧月光光第42集
programme.desc: 此齣為與生活資訊結合的客家戲劇，客語口說藝術的劇場，其中包含了相聲竹板快書、以及說文解字，用活潑逗趣的表演方式，來傳達客家語言

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第355集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第251集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 麻吉樂園LINE TOWN第27集
programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.title: 樂響客庄 關西音樂文化輕旅行第1集
programme.desc: 串連藝術、文化、產業、輕旅行三大領域，期望以關西鎮為據點，透過結合音樂、製茶文化、關西鎮觀光之推廣，鏈結在地與國際文化，將客庄傳統創新再造，擴及世界潮流，並發揚跨領域合作精神，共創信念與價值。

programme.title: 靚靚綠世界第3集
programme.desc: 八個綠色照護故事，讓綠手指們學習撇步一秒上手，不是綠手指，也被植物療癒，花草不再只是花花草草，花草，可以讓我們生活妝點得更美好！

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第137集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家庄裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 一家之煮第510集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 客客客棧第37集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你會聯想到什麼？硬頸精神、勤勞節儉、客家美食，還是滿天飛舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎麼來的呢？又有什麼樣有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(北四縣腔)第1集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(四縣腔)第193集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個關於四位好朋友的故事，他們相聚在一起時，總是充滿了對話、爭吵、歡笑和各種有趣的故事。

programme.title: 初心。登場第19集
programme.desc: 延續「客家製譟」音樂盛典品牌，2025年結合實境拍攝全新打造「初心。登場」系列節目，團隊跨越近一年時間紀錄八組音樂人回歸創作初心，挑戰前所未有的「第一次」登台。從平均年齡最年輕的樂團到搖滾天后，從獨立另類到流行經典，囊括金曲得主、經典唱將、演唱團體、亮眼新秀，多樣曲風加上最感動的創作初心，聯手專業團隊打造出耗資千萬的演唱會！

programme.title: 當晝新聞第363集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 飛越客庄第39集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 胡來旅行社第10集
programme.desc: 胡瓜、小禎、安安，首度合體主持節目，而且還是「實境節目」。三人回到瓜哥的故鄉苗栗經營一家旅行社，從未一起生活、一起工作的他們，會有什麼樣的火花？

programme.title: 客家戲曲第725集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 廚師的迫降-客家廚房2第4集
programme.desc: 這一次，他們要迫降到哪裡？Super Junior 隊長利特再度領軍，帶領臺韓高人氣明星，在首爾漢江展開料理對決！元日主廚對上黑白大廚趙序衡，新舊成員展現各自的魅力，火花四射的第二季，誰能成為最終的贏家？

programme.title: 福氣來了第93集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第14集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(北四縣腔)第1集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(四縣腔)第193集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個關於四位好朋友的故事，他們相聚在一起時，總是充滿了對話、爭吵、歡笑和各種有趣的故事。

programme.title: 小象飛飛第21集
programme.desc: 主題圍繞在友誼的建立與維繫，如何同理互助、面對困難，同時也鼓勵要有大膽冒險的企圖心，透過每一趟探索未知的旅程，培養面對困難並積極挑戰的勇氣。

programme.title: 小象飛飛第22集
programme.desc: 主題圍繞在友誼的建立與維繫，如何同理互助、面對困難，同時也鼓勵要有大膽冒險的企圖心，透過每一趟探索未知的旅程，培養面對困難並積極挑戰的勇氣。

programme.title: 麻吉樂園LINE TOWN第29集
programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1171集

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第363集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所單歌第62集
programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的了解。

programme.title: 客家新聞雜誌第980集

programme.title: 活力新故鄉第93集
programme.desc: 所有的不確定是動能的來源，故鄉的底蘊。活力新故鄉，故鄉新活力漫漫湠散中。

programme.title: 女仨的婚事第1集
programme.desc: 故事從一個貌似喪禮的婚宴開始，這麼奇特的想法讓生性傳統的女方母親劉媽媽大為光火，她搞不懂小女兒好不容易才覓得的幸福為什麼要弄成冰冷的模樣，這不是在觸霉頭嗎？原來這對新人彼此都有過婚姻的經歷，這一次他們要向過去不快的婚姻告別，共同攜手迎向未來。儘管劉媽媽自己的婚姻並不幸福，但她還是期盼著女兒們能擁有幸福的婚姻。深受劉媽媽影響的大女兒在婚姻路上走的並不順遂。嗜酒的二女兒誓言非「最愛」不嫁，依舊單身的她，在婚宴上遇到那曾經被她傷害的男人帶著他的家人出席。劉媽媽有名無實的丈夫竟也出現在婚禮，過往的種種一一浮現。

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第356集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.desc: 故事從一個貌似喪禮的婚宴開始，這麼奇特的想法讓生性傳統的女方母親劉媽媽大為光火，她搞不懂小女兒好不容易才覓得的幸福為什麼要弄成冰冷的模樣，這不是在觸霉頭嗎？原來這對新人彼此都有過婚姻的經歷，這一次他們要向過去不快的婚姻告別，共同攜手迎向未來。儘管劉媽媽自己的婚姻並不幸福，但她還是期盼著女兒們能擁有幸福的婚姻。深受劉媽媽影響的大女兒在婚姻路上走的並不順遂。嗜酒的二女兒誓言非「最愛」不嫁，依舊單身的她，在婚宴上遇到那曾經被她傷害的男人帶著他的家人出席。劉媽媽有名無實的丈夫竟也出現在婚禮，過往的種種一一浮現。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1171集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第13集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理為起點，透過食材的生產關係、食物的料理過程乃至廚師的烹飪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》試著以人與料理的故事，建立與客家概念的連結與對照，勾勒客家飲食多元豐富的面向。

programme.title: 福氣來了第94集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第15集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(海陸腔)第1集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(海陸腔)第193集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個關於四位好朋友的故事，他們相聚在一起時，總是充滿著對話、爭吵和歡笑。

programme.title: 小象飛飛第23集
programme.desc: 主題圍繞在友誼的建立與維繫，如何同理互助、面對困難，同時也鼓勵要有大膽冒險的企圖心，透過每一趟探索未知的旅程，培養面對困難並積極挑戰的勇氣。

programme.title: 小象飛飛第24集
programme.desc: 主題圍繞在友誼的建立與維繫，如何同理互助、面對困難，同時也鼓勵要有大膽冒險的企圖心，透過每一趟探索未知的旅程，培養面對困難並積極挑戰的勇氣。

programme.title: 麻吉樂園LINE TOWN第30集
programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第364集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所單歌第63集
programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的了解。

programme.title: 行李戰爭第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 買家前往印地安納波利斯競標包包、古董和體育紀念品。

programme.title: 白令海大吸金第13季:第4集
programme.desc: 在阿拉斯加的諾姆，淘金熱仍在延燒。在黃金熱推波助瀾下，許多迫切需要用錢的礦工拚了命，也不顧一切駕駛著破舊的挖泥船，潛進變化莫測的冰冷白令海底，全為了吸金撈一筆。

programme.title: 原始生活之末日世界第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 十二位《原始生活》的明星與新秀，再度挑戰極限！這一次，他們被丟進一片荒蕪、宛如末日的絕境。這裡，曾有人類嘗試生存，卻無一成功。這片土地由獅子、花豹、鬣狗與河馬等掠食者主宰，他們身上只有基本工具，必須在鬼城、墓園、垃圾場與廢棄礦坑的殘骸中尋找可以利用的資源，撐過35天重返文明世界。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第16季:第11集
programme.desc: 德魯與堤伊先去了南倫敦的莫布勒，在這裡深受非洲與歐洲藝術文化融合的衝擊。接著前往納伯斯的麥芽屋，德魯買到欲罷不能。最後前往基斯利的好物屋。

programme.title: 西班牙邊境護衛隊第5季:第13集
programme.desc: 馬德里機場的海關人員懷疑旅客的行李箱內有假背板藏匿不法物品，打開後果然找到古柯鹼。

programme.title: 西班牙邊境護衛隊第5季:第14集
programme.desc: 巴塞隆納機場的海關人員攔下攜帶超過一萬歐元現金且未申報的旅客，旅客堅稱9500歐元是公司的錢。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人-經典好車第1季:第1集

programme.title: 盲蛙牧場藏寶之謎第4季:第16集

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 由於釀酒執照取得困難，葛倫史登斯決定改以啤酒結合燒烤開設餐廳，與本地酒廠合作，推出自有品牌，將餐飲商品行銷全國。他賣車買房、再轉賣牟利的計畫進展順利，創業資金有望，也成功取得團隊成員的信任與同意，開始逐步為開設餐廳做準備。但就在這時，他們動手整修房屋才發現屋裡長了黴斑，能否順利賣出成了未知數，倘若賣屋失敗，葛倫的計畫也將全盤泡湯。

programme.desc: 葛倫需要四萬美元創業資金，成敗就看房子能否順利轉賣。但動工整修之後，問題逐一浮現。先是有黴菌須請專家清除，後又有人力與時間吃緊的困難。雖然另一方面，葛倫與麥特終於成功說服酒廠的克里斯與他們合作，阿傑也順利找到能主持廚房的燒烤廚師，肋排節的參與資格以及未來的店面也都有了著落。然而房子如果不能及時賣出，所有計畫終成泡影。葛倫開始擔心他不僅會創業失敗，更會令團隊失望。

programme.title: 白令海大吸金第13季:第4集
programme.desc: 在阿拉斯加的諾姆，淘金熱仍在延燒。在黃金熱推波助瀾下，許多迫切需要用錢的礦工拚了命，也不顧一切駕駛著破舊的挖泥船，潛進變化莫測的冰冷白令海底，全為了吸金撈一筆。

programme.desc: 「只有海底能阻止我們潛得更深！」簡單一句話即說明了海軍水下作業大隊的任務。作戰時，支援海上滲透，協助獵雷艦執行各港口水雷清除及障礙物爆破等工作。平時則負責處理水中械彈、水下船體檢查與修補、清除港灣障礙物等深海水域工作，風災後也常看見水下作業大隊參與救災的身影，保衛著人民的生命安全；2010年颱風催毀蘇花公路，造成遊覽車翻覆，車上遊客全數掉進太平洋罹難，當時在危險的海域與惡劣的天候情況進行海底搜救任務的就是海軍水下作業大隊。與一般海軍不同，除了必須深諳水性、熟悉機械與救難知識外，更重要的是學習如何在海底面對水下的各種危險與險惡環境，安全地執行任務。12週的訓練中，隊員們需接受踩水、潛泳、水肺及1
